packages.what: Gestures such as chop for torch and twist for camera.
packages.breaks: Chop-for-torch, twist-for-camera and three-finger screenshot stop working.

packages.what: Shows notifications on the sleeping screen.
packages.breaks: Peek Display stops; the screen stays off for notifications.

packages.what: Messages from Motorola about your phone.

packages.breaks: Some Motorola account services stop.

packages.what: The home-screen clock and weather widget.
packages.breaks: The clock and weather widget goes blank.

packages.breaks: FM radio is unavailable.

packages.name: Moto Secure
packages.breaks: The Moto Secure app and its secure folder entry are unavailable.

packages.breaks: Ready For / Smart Connect stops working.

packages.name: Dolby Atmos
packages.breaks: Dolby sound settings cannot be opened.

packages.name: Personalise
packages.breaks: You cannot change theme, font or icon shape.

packages.name: Moto Care
packages.breaks: Motorola support features inside Settings may stop.

packages.name: Bug2Go
packages.what: Collects logs for Motorola bug reports.
packages.breaks: You cannot send bug reports to Motorola.
